name: infinite-grid
title: Infinite Grid
blurb: 3D grid of cards with click interaction, infinite panning, and shader effects.
description: A WebGL-based card gallery that renders images in 3D space with mouse-controlled panning, distortion post-processing, and vignette effects. Emits events on tile load and click.
use_when: Immersive media portfolios or galleries where 3D depth and interactive panning create visual impact.
avoid_when: On low-end devices or without WebGL support. Requires explicit parent sizing or the component collapses.
a11y: Click events dispatched via custom tile-clicked event; no native keyboard navigation or prefers-reduced-motion support in the code.
